preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is an integer between 3 and 100,000 inclusive.
The target angle a is an integer between 1 and 180 inclusive.
Both n and a are integers.

postconditions.expression: len(parts) == 3 and all(v in range(1, n + 1) for v in parts) and len(set(parts)) == 3
postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly three distinct integers between 1 and n inclusive, representing vertices v1, v2, v3.

postconditions.expression: min_diff == min(abs(k * 180 / n - a) for k in range(1, n - 1))
postconditions.description: The absolute difference between the formed angle and the target angle a is minimized among all possible angles formable by the regular n-gon.
The angle formed by the chosen vertices corresponds to k_opt steps along the polygon perimeter, where k_opt is the integer step count that minimizes the difference.
